newsitem.title: THAILAND: Finance One, TDB stocks suspended.
newsitem.headline: Finance One, TDB stocks suspended.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand on Monday suspended Finance One Plc and Thai Danu Bank Plc on requests by the two firms over concerns that reports of their merger would affect their stock prices.

The two firms filed suspension requests to the bourse after market rumours of their merger on Friday and subsequent statements by Central Bank Governor Rerngchai Marakanond and the Finance Minister Amnuay Viravan on the weekend that they backed the decision of the two firms.
Finance One, Thailand's biggest finance company, and Thai Danu, ranked 12th among 15 Thai commercial banks, have not officially clarified the reasons for their merger.
Rerngchai on Saturday dismissed market speculation that Finance One had agreed to the merger because of its short-term liquidity problem. He said the finance firm is sound and strong.
Rerngchai said the merger was a normal commercial decision designed to strengthen the financial positions and efficiency of the parties involved.
